name: Quantum Computer Cabinet
artDescription: Pixel-art tall navy quantum computer cabinet with a glass front revealing a golden chandelier of stacked plates and violet cables.

name: Fusion Containment Torus
artDescription: Pixel-art massive silver fusion torus held inside dark magnetic brackets, with a luminous magenta circular plasma channel.

name: Cryogenic Electron Microscope
artDescription: Pixel-art towering cream electron microscope with a narrow silver column, frosted blue coolant tank and dark circular specimen chamber.

name: Photonic Supercomputer
artDescription: Pixel-art angular black supercomputer with stacked iridescent optical panels, bright rainbow fiber loops and blue cooling cylinders.

name: Ion Thruster Assembly
artDescription: Pixel-art silver spacecraft ion engine with concentric circular grids, copper coils and a long narrow blue exhaust glow.

name: Magnetic Levitation Sled
artDescription: Pixel-art sleek silver magnetic sled hovering above two dark rails, with frosty cyan coils and a small orange instrument seat.

name: Orbital Laser Communications Terminal
artDescription: Pixel-art white orbital laser terminal with a large gold-rimmed optical head, articulated blue gimbal and narrow red aiming beam.

name: Planetary Radar Array
artDescription: Pixel-art broad curved silver planetary radar grid with many blue circular antenna cells, orange braces and a compact black control pedestal.

name: Solar Sail Probe
artDescription: Pixel-art tiny gold space probe centered within four enormous triangular iridescent solar-sail panels stretched on fine black booms.

name: Deep-Space Navigation Core
artDescription: Pixel-art open hexagonal silver navigation core with nested gold gyroscope rings surrounding a bright violet crystal and blue star-map panels.

name: Cryogenic Sample Vault
artDescription: Pixel-art heavy blue cryogenic sample vault with a thick open round door, frost-covered drawers and six glowing cyan specimen capsules.

name: Robotic Exoskeleton
artDescription: Pixel-art empty orange-and-silver robotic exoskeleton standing upright with articulated legs, powerful shoulder braces and a dark chest harness.

name: Orbital Docking Collar
artDescription: Pixel-art large white orbital docking ring with six orange latches, layered black seals and three extended silver alignment arms.

name: Plasma Glass Furnace
artDescription: Pixel-art armored charcoal plasma furnace with two curved violet arc electrodes above a bright amber pool of molten glass.

name: Vacuum Deposition Chamber
artDescription: Pixel-art polished spherical vacuum deposition chamber with several brass side ports, a purple viewing window and a blue lower pump stack.

name: Atomic Frequency Standard
artDescription: Pixel-art cream laboratory frequency-standard rack with a long copper resonance tube, cyan numeric windows and violet shielded coils.

name: Gravitational Wave Interferometer
artDescription: Pixel-art silver L-shaped interferometer with two long perpendicular vacuum arms, red laser channels and a blue central beam-splitter chamber.

name: Particle Beam Injector
artDescription: Pixel-art long copper particle-beam injector passing through four dark magnetic collars, with a violet source chamber and a narrow cyan beam.

name: Neutrino Detector Vessel
artDescription: Pixel-art cutaway blue cylindrical detector vessel lined with many golden sensor bulbs surrounding a luminous clear central volume.

name: Aerogel Capture Capsule
artDescription: Pixel-art open bronze space-return capsule with a pale-blue translucent honeycomb capture tray and a scorched dark heat shield.

name: Superconducting Power Buffer
artDescription: Pixel-art thick violet superconducting energy-storage ring in a frost-covered silver cradle with blue inverter fins and red power cables.

name: Quantum Entanglement Bench
artDescription: Pixel-art black optical laboratory table carrying twin violet crystal modules joined by intersecting red and blue beams through tiny gold mirrors.

name: Adaptive Optics Mirror
artDescription: Pixel-art large segmented hexagonal telescope mirror with iridescent gold tiles and many silver actuator rods visible behind its dark frame.

name: Rotating Space Habitat
artDescription: Pixel-art white rotating space habitat ring with blue window bands, four silver spokes and a central gold docking hub.

name: Autonomous Cargo Capsule
artDescription: Pixel-art blunt-nosed silver cargo capsule with an open orange freight bay, folded dark landing legs and a blue navigation panel.

name: Ocean-Floor Observatory
artDescription: Pixel-art deep-sea observatory with three blue glass pressure spheres inside an orange tripod frame and a tall black sensor mast.

name: Precision Wind Tunnel
artDescription: Pixel-art silver precision wind tunnel with a large honeycomb intake, transparent central chamber, tiny red wing model and blue laser sheet.

name: Photonic Encryption Router
artDescription: Pixel-art flat black encryption router with eight luminous rainbow optical ports, a violet central core window and gold-edged cooling fins.

name: Space Elevator Climber
artDescription: Pixel-art orange space-elevator climber gripping a tall dark ribbon with four silver roller banks and two broad blue power panels.

name: Deep-Space Observatory Satellite
artDescription: Pixel-art large gold-and-silver observatory satellite with an open dark telescope barrel, broad blue solar wings and a layered silver sunshield.
